address: 18/15 Pimpasut Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Khon Kaen, Khon Kaen, 40000, Thailand
bio: The history of this egg noodle soup spot stretches back more than 70 years to the owner’s grandfather. Today, it still satisfies — especially the noodle soup with wontons and barbecue pork (the noodles and wontons are homemade) and the deep-fried noodles with gravy and pork or beef....
